summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release updating its Euro 250 million Third Tranche buyback, part of an approximately Euro 3.5 billion multi-year program announced September 1, 2026 and targeted for completion by 2030. Between October 26-30, 2026, Ferrari repurchased 28,800 common shares on Euronext Milan at an average of Euro 352.1865, totaling Euro 10.14 million. Since the tranche began, Euro 130.5 million has bought 370,061 EXM shares plus 77,824 NYSE shares for USD 31.5 million; treasury holds 2,038,689 shares (1.15% of common, 0.87% of capital). Watch execution pace and any acceleration signal.
